metadata.title: Morse homology of nonsingular Morse-Smale foliations and its duality theorem
metadata.abstract: We define a Morse homology of the foliation which is defined by a general nonsingular Morse-Smale flow, applying the framework of the Conley index theory. In fact, we define a chain and a boundary homomorphism, therefore, a cochain and a cohomology are obtained as well. Furthermore, we prove a duality theorem on the homology and the cohomology.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 叶状结构的Morse同调与对偶
analysis.workSummary: 利用Conley指标框架为一般无奇点Morse–Smale流定义的叶状结构建立Morse链群及边界同态，由此得到上链和上同调，并证明同调与上同调的对偶。
analysis.breakthrough: 给无奇点流产生的叶状结构构造Morse型代数不变量。
analysis.limitations: 摘要未说明系数、次数移位及额外定向假设。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
